papers.title_en: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
papers.authors: Wei Minn, Zhensu Sun, Lwin Khin Shar, David Lo
papers.evidence: 编码智能体互相评测并生成缺陷测试的自扩展竞技场
papers.tldr: 静态编程基准发布即固定，任务易泄漏且被强智能体饱和。SWE-Duel提出自扩展竞技场：红蓝双方镜像轮换，红方在真实仓库中植入隐蔽缺陷并生成封存测试，蓝方盲审修复，通过三重测试才得分。1500轮、11个模型-工具组合、15个多语言仓库的锦标赛显示，GPT-5.5+Codex CLI修复98.3%缺陷居首，Claude Opus 4.8+mini-swe-agent红方胜率27.3%。同族新版本生成的任务更难，初步证明难度可随作者能力扩展。
papers.abstract_en: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository's existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.

papers.title_en: TestSuiteBench: Coding Agents Struggle to Generate Strong Test Suites from Specifications
papers.authors: Kazuki Egashira, Niels Mündler-Sasahara, Mark Niklas Müller, Martin Vechev
papers.evidence: 评测编码智能体从规格生成完整测试套件的基准
papers.tldr: 测试生成基准多局限于单函数或修复，缺少从规格生成完整测试套件的评测。作者提出 TestSuiteBench，含165个开源应用、行为规格、参考实现、参考测试套件及平均74个变异体，每个变异体对应单条需求并用于隔离行为。前沿编码智能体生成测试套件虽大多有效且88%通过参考实现，但变异分数不足60%，常缺关键输入组合且规模偏小。同一规格生成的实现却能通过82%参考测试，揭示智能体能造软件却难以验证软件，制约全自主开发。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly used to create large software projects. While code-generation benchmarks have scaled accordingly to full applications, test-generation benchmarks remain limited to individual functions or bug fixes. In particular, generating complete test suites for complex software from scratch remains unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce TestSuiteBench, a benchmark of 165 open-source applications, each with a structured and detailed specification of intended behavior, a reference implementation, a reference test suite, and on average 74 mutants. Each mutant is generated from a single requirement of the specification and refined to isolate that behavior: 73\% are killed by exactly one reference test and, on average, by only 0.2\% of the remaining tests. We find that even frontier coding agents struggle to generate strong test suites given our specifications, achieving mutation scores below 60\%, despite their suites being largely valid and 88\% of their tests passing on the reference implementation. We observe that generated test suites often lack relevant input combinations and are smaller than reference test suites. Meanwhile, implementations generated for the same specifications pass 82\% of the reference tests. These results show agents can build software they cannot verify, a gap that directly limits fully autonomous software development.

papers.title_en: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
papers.authors: Jiajun Hu, Chun Yong Chong
papers.evidence: 用于评估编码智能体轨迹的验证器
papers.tldr: 面向端到端软件工程任务的编码智能体常缺少可用的成功判定标准，且其轨迹长达数百步交互，验证困难。现有验证器或直接使用通用LLM，或只训练输出标量奖励的专用评论器。SWE-Critix提出通用轨迹验证器的后训练流程，结合SFT与RL，让30B模型同时预测完成标签并生成自然语言分析。在CodeForge-Preview留出测试集上，准确率从基座57%提升至SFT 66%、RL 78%。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.

papers.title_en: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang, Hongjin Qian, Yuyang Hu, Jiajun Zhang, Zheng Liu
papers.evidence: 评测编码智能体创建与编辑智能体的基准
papers.tldr: 随着软件生产日益交由软件自身完成，编码智能体被委托构建贴合用户工作流的智能体，但交付物是否真正满足需求尚无基准检验。AgentSWE 覆盖智能体软件工程三阶段：按自然语言需求创建、编辑生产级代码库、面向可测目标优化，共25个委托式任务。构建者可基于少量示例迭代，验收则在留出用例上冻结评测，按需求衍生评分标准严格判定。结果显示现有编码智能体普遍无法交付需求，演示与交付之间存在系统性差距。
papers.abstract_en: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.

papers.title_en: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
papers.authors: Chengyi Yang, Renxu Bao, Jue Hou, Zongpei Teng, Ziheng Wang, Yujie Lin, Chengsong Huang, Junnan Zhu, Delai Qiu, Yining Wang, Shengping Liu, Fei Long, Jinsong Su
papers.evidence: 面向长周期编码智能体的训练环境
papers.tldr: 面向从零构建程序的长程编码智能体，现有可验证训练环境稀缺，且工作流难以支撑先探索参考程序再实现的长程开发。为此，本文提出 ProgramGym，包含 Program-Env 与 Program-Agent：前者用反馈驱动循环修复运行时沙箱和黑盒测试，构建覆盖 C、C++、Go、Rust 的 1,648 个可验证环境；后者以分析、实现、审查角色隔离流程配合修订管理，支持编译检查与失败恢复。在 ProgramBench 上，基于这些环境微调将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.87% 提升至 42.84%，Program-Agent 进一步把 base 与 SFT 模型提升至 55.71% 和 56.25%，超过部分旗舰模型。该工作为从零构建程序的可扩展训练提供环境、流程与数据。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.

papers.title_en: (When) Should a Software Factory be Lights-off? Benchmarking Code Review Agents on Bug Detection
papers.authors: Chenyang Yang, Hao He, Ti-Chung Cheng, Jenna Butler, Emerson Murphy-Hill, Carmen Badea, Christian Bird
papers.evidence: 评估代码审查代理缺陷检测能力的基准
papers.tldr: 随着编码智能体普及，开发者审代码的时间已超过写代码，自动化评审走向"无人值守"软件工厂成为诱人设想。为此作者构建 CRBugBench，从仓库历史挖掘人工确认的缺陷并配对引入 PR 形成评审任务，覆盖 98 个开源仓库 1000 个任务及某大厂 800 个私有任务。评测显示最强组合 claude-opus-5 搭配 copilot-cli 在前 5 条评论内命中 71.9% 缺陷，五个月内从 47.7% 大幅提升。但复杂改动与非局部推理缺陷仍薄弱，私有仓库因需项目上下文而明显掉分，说明完全无人化尚不现实。
papers.abstract_en: With the advances of coding agents, software developers are spending more time reviewing code than writing code. As human review velocity falls behind agentic code generation, it is tempting to build automated review agents towards a future of "lights-off" software factory with little to no human supervision. To assess the practicality of such a fully autonomous software factory, we construct CRBugBench, a new benchmark that evaluates whether review agents detect human-verified bugs. We build a data pipeline that mines bugs from repository history, and pair each bug with its introducing PR to form a review task. CRBugBench consists of 1,000 review tasks across 98 open-source GitHub repositories, and 800 additional tasks from proprietary industry repositories at one large company.   We then use the benchmark to study agent review quality: We found that SOTA review agents do well: the best (claude-opus-5 with copilot-cli) catches 71.9% of bugs within its top-5 comments, up from 47.7% (opus-4.6) in five months of model evolution. Yet agents remain less effective on complex changes and bugs requiring non-local reasoning, with sharp performance drops on proprietary industry repositories where project context is more often needed. To improve bug detection, we found scaling compute helps most through prompt changes: exploration-nudging prompts gain up to 5.8% performance at 10% higher cost. From these findings, we derive concrete guidance for developers to adopt review agents - scaling review effort to PR complexity, steering agents by project priorities, supplying repository knowledge, dispatching models by PR characteristics, and monitoring quality as models evolve.

papers.title_en: Don't Guess, Just Ask: Evaluating Interactive Requirement Clarification for Repository-Level Software Development
papers.authors: Mingyu Chen, Zhiqing Zhong, Manyi Wang, Linxi Liang, Rouyu Chen, Pinjia He
papers.evidence: 评估仓库级大模型软件开发中的交互式需求澄清
papers.tldr: 现有基准多从完整或欠明确需求直接评测代码实现，忽视编码前的需求澄清；仓库级开发中误解更会传播并造成返工。论文提出 ReqClarifyBench，含游戏、小程序、网页三类共341个任务，并用多角色 LLM 用户模拟器交互评测。实验显示澄清效果更强未必带来更高需求文档质量，且表现随用户角色显著变化；编码智能体框架也未比基座 LLM 提升文档质量。该工作为端到端 LLM 软件开发系统提供了交互澄清评测基准与洞察。
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs become increasingly capable of implementing software, a critical bottleneck emerges: whether they truly understand what users want. Users often begin with vague intent, leaving important requirements to be clarified through interaction. In repository-level development, misunderstandings can propagate and cause costly rework. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate implementation from complete specifications or underspecified requests, overlooking pre-coding requirement clarification. Prior clarification studies mainly focus on function-level tasks. It therefore remains unclear how well LLMs can transform vague intent into clear requirements through interaction and how this capability affects subsequent code generation.   We introduce ReqClarifyBench, an interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development. It contains 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development, each with a vague user intent, a human-validated requirement document, and code evaluation artifacts. We employ LLM-based user simulators with diverse personas derived from real-world conversations. We evaluate six LLMs in terms of clarification effectiveness and generated requirement document quality. Results show that stronger clarification effectiveness does not necessarily translate into higher document quality, and performance varies substantially across user personas. We also find that coding-agent harnesses do not further improve requirement document quality compared with their base LLMs. These findings offer insights for building LLM-based end-to-end software development systems.

papers.title_en: Quality, Not Just Outcome: A Structural Scoring Framework for Selecting Coding-Agent Trajectories for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Sida Li, Yuanxin Liu, Shicheng Li, Linli Yao, Xu Sun, Haoli Bai, Xiaohui Li
papers.evidence: 按过程质量对编码智能体轨迹打分以做监督微调
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体常按最终补丁是否通过测试来筛选监督微调轨迹，却忽略过程质量，成功轨迹也可能包含重复查看文件、工具使用不稳或延迟修改等低效模式。为此，作者提出 TQS（Trajectory Quality Score），一种直接基于轨迹结构、无需 LLM 评判且线性时间运行的质量评分框架，围绕信息聚焦、意图-动作对齐与策略动态等结构化收敛信号打分。在 155,144 条成功轨迹上按 TQS 排序并筛选微调后，使用高分轨迹的模型在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上稳定优于随机或低分子集。该工作表明过程级轨迹质量对编码智能体监督很重要，结构过滤是可扩展的替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose TQS (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for coding-agent trajectories that operates directly on trajectory structure, requires no LLM judge, and runs in linear time. TQS characterizes trajectory quality through structural signals organized around structured convergence: information focus, intent--action alignment, and policy dynamics. Using 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus, we rank trajectories by TQS and fine-tune coding agents on filtered subsets. Models trained on top-ranked trajectories consistently outperform those trained on random or bottom-ranked subsets on SWE-Bench-Verified. Our results suggest that process-level trajectory quality is an important factor in coding-agent supervision and that structural trajectory filtering provides an effective and scalable alternative to LLM-based data selection.

papers.title_en: Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis
papers.authors: Yongjian Tang, Costel Moraru, Doruk Tuncel, Hanya Elhashemy, Steffen Klepke, Thomas Runkler
papers.evidence: 多智能体框架优化API规约与文档
papers.tldr: 现有LLM生成API规范多为一次性，缺乏持续验证、维护与市场演进。Agent4Spec提出自主多智能体框架：验证流水线检测并自纠OpenAPI语法错误，市场分析流水线开展竞品研究、识别功能缺口并自动补全API功能。在通用与工业数据集上，最佳模型达100%语法错误检测、超95%修正成功率与超50%端点改进采纳率。该工作将API规范优化拓展为可验证、市场驱动的持续闭环。
papers.abstract_en: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event - overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. To address this issue, we present Agent4Spec, an autonomous multi-agent framework featuring two distinct pipelines: (1) a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and (2) a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities. We evaluate Agent4Spec on two curated datasets of API specifications spanning both general-purpose and industrial scenarios. Among 9 SOTA LLMs, the top-performer achieves 100% syntax error detection rates and over 95% implementation success for proposed corrections, while securing over 50% adoption rates for suggested endpoint improvements, representing a practical tool for API development.

papers.title_en: A-SAW: The Agentic Software Architecture Workflow
papers.authors: Finn Klatt, Luca Di Grazia, Johannes Schneider
papers.evidence: 面向架构文档生成的智能体工作流
papers.tldr: 软件工程AI辅助多集中于实现与验证，架构设计文档维护仍碎片化且依赖作者。本文提出A-SAW，在架构即代码上增加常驻智能体层，由IDE智能体基于版本化C4模型、类型化元素目录与模板起草文档，并设强制人工评审门。工业评估中，工作流消除作者间方差，匹配对内在质量中位数提升19分；生成文档完整性100%、一致性93%、机器可读性99%、可追溯性79%。13名实践者中11人拒绝未经人工评审的输出，支持将评审集中在智能体需超出仓库推断之处。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistance in software engineering focuses on implementation and verification, leaving the design phase, and in particular the maintenance of architecture documentation, comparatively underserved. Architecture as Code makes architectural artifacts versionable, diffable, and machine-readable, but it does not reduce the effort of keeping them updated, so design documentation still ends up as a fragmented, author-dependent, and only partially trusted record of why a system looks the way it does.   In this paper we introduce the Agentic Software Architecture Workflow (A-SAW), a process-level artifact that extends Architecture as Code with a persistent agent layer: an IDE-integrated agent drafts architecture documents from a version-controlled C4 model, a typed element catalog, and instrumented templates. Every draft passes a mandatory human review gate before it is accepted. We evaluate it in a large industrial organization along two tracks: a rubric assessment of 45 architecture documents including 13 matched source-regeneration pairs, and 13 task-anchored practitioner interviews. Our results show that the workflow collapses the between-author variance that made quality unpredictable. Intrinsic quality also rises, by a median of +19 points across the matched pair. The cohort has a mean of 58% and 89% bundle templates, catalog, agent, and a richer regeneration context. So they bound the agent's contribution from above rather than isolating it. In the agent-generated documents, completeness (100%), consistency (93%), and machine-readability (99%) reach or approach the rubric maximum, while traceability reaches 79%. Eleven of the 13 participants rejected agent output that no human had reviewed, and one warned that polished output may lead reviewers to skip the review. Our work supports keeping human review mandatory and concentrating it where the agent must infer beyond the repository.

papers.title_en: Agentic Large Language Models
papers.authors: Max van Duijn, Michiel van der Meer, Aske Plaat, Niki van Stein
papers.evidence: 关于能够行动与交互的智能体化大模型的著作
papers.tldr: 大语言模型已深度影响写作、问答与决策，但通常被动响应，尚不能直接在世界中行动，也难以彼此协作。Agentic LLMs 把 LLM 的推理能力与真实世界行动能力结合，使模型能主动执行任务并相互交互。本书系统讨论这类智能体的工作原理、行动方式、交互模式及其对用户的影响，并探讨其能力边界。它为理解自主智能体时代的人机关系、决策机制与潜在风险提供整体框架。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm. Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more. Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions. What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly? What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other? Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world. In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.

papers.title_en: Byte Language Models: Scaling, Emergent Abstractions, and Information Allocation
papers.authors: Jie Wang, Shiwei Luo, Qi Zhang, Yuanbin Wu
papers.evidence: 字节级语言模型与 Transformer 规模扩展
papers.tldr: 字节语言模型免分词器，直接将文本建模为字节，但序列更长、计算更大且缺乏显式文本抽象，这带来计算开销与抽象缺失的双重挑战。作者在无专用架构的 Transformer 上研究该额外计算是否有用，以及能否学得分词器提供的抽象。通过 token-superposition 训练与哈希嵌入，字节 Transformer 随规模扩大持续优于子词模型，并涌现出类似分词的局部抽象。该结构还使生成不确定性集中在局部边界，用于投机解码可显著提升接受 token 数。
papers.abstract_en: Tokenizer-free language models remove the inductive bias of fixed tokenizers by modeling text directly as bytes, but the resulting longer sequences substantially increase computation and eliminate explicit text abstractions. We ask whether this additional computation can be useful, and whether standard Transformers can learn the abstractions that tokenization provides. We study these questions on Transformers without specialized tokenization-related architectures. With token-superposition training and hash embeddings, byte Transformers consistently outperform subword Transformers as model size scales. We further find that byte Transformers build local text abstractions as external tokenizers: a set of segmentation-like positions are used to collect local context representations, and restricting up to $25\%$ of intermediate layers to these local representations preserves downstream performance. Finally, these learned structures induce highly non-uniform generation difficulty, with uncertainty concentrated near local structure boundaries; exploiting them for speculative decoding yields $3.4\times$ more accepted tokens than in subword Transformers.

papers.title_en: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
papers.authors: Tamara Czinczoll, Julie Kallini, Gerard de Melo, Chen Shani
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的轻量潜在多词元预测
papers.tldr: 下一词预测是大模型标准预训练目标，但仅监督紧邻词，易使模型利用局部模式，忽略长程结构与思想。多词预测可扩展监督，却常引入大量新参数且下游提升有限；隐式多词预测虽省参数，却依赖外部辅助模型编码未来词。LightMTP从模型自身隐藏状态自举未来词表示，提出两种轻量隐式多词预测变体，将监督扩展至更多未来词，且无需常规多词预测的额外算力或外部监督。它最多新增1%参数，在通用语言建模基准保持更优表现，并在规划、编码与推理取得相近增益。
papers.abstract_en: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.

papers.title_en: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Byeonghu Na, Donghyeok Shin, Yeongmin Kim, Mina Kang, Il-Chul Moon
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的知识蒸馏方法
papers.tldr: 自回归大语言模型能力增强但推理开销高，知识蒸馏通过分布对齐压缩模型。现有LLM蒸馏方法多依赖逐词表索引的概率散度，未显式利用词元语义。WASD引入基于词元嵌入代价矩阵的Wasserstein距离，并用Sinkhorn散度推导梯度等价目标，无需额外网络即可高效优化。在多种LLM家族与规模上，WASD在指令跟随、数学推理和代码生成任务中稳定提升蒸馏性能，凸显词元空间语义信息对分布对齐的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .

papers.title_en: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Dayan Pan, Jingyuan Wang, Xie Yu
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型适配的参数高效微调方法
papers.tldr: 现有PEFT方法多采用均匀静态适配，忽略注意力在维度、头、层与输入token上的结构化异质性，且RoPE引入维度相关位置结构，使均匀适配次优。为此提出DyPAM，直接在query与key表示上调制位置信息对注意力的贡献，融合输入条件化的维度级调制及头级、层级结构调制，且不修改预训练主干。在数学与常识推理基准上，跨多个主干模型一致超越强PEFT基线。该工作实现了与RoPE结构对齐的细粒度位置注意力适配，提升了参数高效微调的性能。
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

papers.title_en: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
papers.authors: Rongxue Li, Meng Yang, Yiru Mao, Yongliang Tao, Lulu Hu, Bin Yang, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Bowen Xu
papers.evidence: 从经校验的编码智能体轨迹中自蒸馏
papers.tldr: 空间编码智能体虽能借助外部工具提升多模态大模型的空间推理，却带来高推理开销与外部依赖。SpatialOPSD 将已验证的智能体执行轨迹作为特权信息，通过同策略自蒸馏把工具化空间推理内化到独立 MLLM 中。为缓解特权信息泄漏，方法引入重复感知蒸馏，结合重复掩码与无似然正则。多基准实验显示其平均准确率超过 SFT 与 GRPO，并在空间及 OOD 数据上展现更强泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.

papers.title_en: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
papers.authors: Tian Jin, Wenhao Wang, Jing Kang, Haoting Shi, Rui Ye, Yijun Lu, Siheng Chen
papers.evidence: 合成软件环境以训练计算机使用智能体
papers.tldr: 计算机使用智能体训练受限于软件环境稀缺：原生应用构建成本高、覆盖窄且易过拟合，浏览器环境交互深度不足。SoftwareGym 提出自动化流水线，合成界面多样、可执行且经运行验证的 GUI 软件环境，并用 GUI 评估与迭代修复保障可靠性。它合成 12 类 182 个应用，GUI 任务平均通过率 91.5%，构建 120 任务 SoftwareGym-Bench。用其轨迹训练后，OSWorld Pass@3 从 41.39% 升至 56.97%，并在新基准达 40.0%，表明合成环境是可扩展、可迁移的监督信号。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. Native application environments require substantial construction and integration effort, which limits application coverage and increases the risk of application-specific overfitting. Browser-hosted environments provide limited interaction depth and workflow complexity. These limitations motivate SoftwareGym, an automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI software environments with diverse interfaces, executable functionality, and runtime-verified behavior. It generates structurally diverse designs, realizes them as runnable applications, and uses GUI evaluation with iterative repair to ensure functional reliability. Using SoftwareGym, we synthesize 182 applications across twelve categories and achieve a mean GUI task pass rate of 91.5%. We construct SoftwareGym-Bench, a 120-task evaluation suite spanning the same twelve categories, and use trajectories collected from these environments for CUA training. The resulting model improves Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% on the strictly out-of-domain OSWorld benchmark and achieves 40.0% on SoftwareGym-Bench. These results demonstrate the potential of synthesized software environments as scalable and transferable supervision for CUA training.

papers.title_en: From Delivery to Stateful Exploration: Rethinking the Index for Agentic Search
papers.authors: Deogyong Kim, Sunghwan Kim, Sangam Lee, Wonjae Lee, Dongha Lee
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体检索的索引原生接口
papers.tldr: LLM智能体搜索中，检索接口常直接返回匹配文本片段，使候选集筛选与原文暴露耦合。为此提出IndexAct接口，让智能体通过倒排索引上的词法条件与集合运算构建并操作持久化候选集，仅返回可复用状态引用与候选数量等统计，文本片段需另行请求。在五个智能体搜索与多跳问答基准上均优于基线，BrowseComp-Plus上以更小活跃上下文取得更高证据覆盖，并随语料扩张保持准确率。这表明有效筛选反馈与状态复用才是关键，而非缩短上下文或减少步数。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in agentic search have given large language model (LLM) agents finer control over corpus exploration. However, search interfaces often return matching passages even when feedback about the candidate set would suffice for the next decision, coupling candidate refinement with source-text exposure. We propose IndexAct, an interface for Index-Native Corpus Interaction that separates candidate-set refinement from text inspection. Agents construct and manipulate persistent candidate sets through lexical conditions and set operations over an inverted index, receiving reusable state references and statistics such as candidate counts rather than matching passages. This feedback guides further refinement, while separately requested passages provide new clues or evidence that can inform subsequent operations on retained candidate sets. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning agentic search and multi-hop question answering show that IndexAct outperforms the evaluated baselines on each benchmark. On BrowseComp-Plus, it also achieves higher evidence coverage with a smaller average live context than terminal-based corpus interfaces, and maintains answer accuracy as the corpus expands. Further analyses suggest that informative refinement feedback and state reuse support continued evidence discovery, while shorter contexts or fewer search steps alone do not ensure better performance.

papers.title_en: Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness
papers.authors: Yihan Li, Hanyi Zhang, Xiaoxi Jiang, Man Guo
papers.evidence: 用大模型编辑器优化标注定义的智能体流水线
papers.tldr: 许多标注项目在专家尚未形成稳定规范、标签不足以训练专用模型时就已经启动。Goldsmith 将小型金标集（代表任务边界的专家校准样例）转化为可复用的结构化标注定义，并把该定义视为可训练文本对象：候选定义在同一批金标上运行，由可执行结构化损失打分，LLM 编辑器将高损失失败转为文本梯度修订，仅在损失下降时接受，输出模式、检索、修复、评判与人工复核留在外部 harness 中。在匹配评测协议下，它优于直接改写、OPRO、APE 与 PromptBreeder，并在类型化跨度、成对关系、固定触发词事件论元等任务的下游标注中，结合检索、基于分数的路由与人工复核带来提升。这表明稀缺的专家监督可同时支撑任务定义学习与规模化标注。
papers.abstract_en: Many annotation projects begin before experts have a stable guideline or enough labels to train a task-specific model. We present Goldsmith, an agentic pipeline that turns a small gold set---expert-annotated calibration examples representing the intended task boundaries---into a reusable structured annotation definition. Goldsmith treats this definition as a trainable textual object. Candidate definitions are run on the same gold examples and scored with an executable structured loss, while the output schema, formatting, retrieval, repair, judging, and human review remain in an external harness. A large language model (LLM) editor converts the highest-loss failures into textual-gradient revisions, which are accepted only when the measured loss decreases. In prompt-optimization comparisons, Goldsmith improves over direct rewriting, OPRO, APE, and PromptBreeder under matched evaluation protocols. The resulting definition also improves downstream annotation when combined with retrieval, score-based routing, and human review across typed span, pair-level relation, and fixed-trigger event-argument tasks. These results show that scarce expert supervision can support both task-definition learning and scalable annotation.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
papers.authors: Justus Flerlage, Thorsten Wittkopp, Alexander Acker, Odej Kao
papers.evidence: 基于大模型的机器人控制代码生成
papers.tldr: 在未知动态环境中部署机器人，需要从固定指令库转向基于意图的自主控制，自然语言成为表达复杂目标的关键媒介。本文提出双AI架构：LLM将高层意图翻译为受形式化机器人库与可验证语法约束的可执行代码，VLM通过蒸馏提供语义落地。框架还加入基于几何与语义阈值的环境重规划触发、运行时监控和自适应规划循环。在多个前沿模型上评测表明，将生成式AI置于反应式受限闭环中，能稳健完成动态未知环境下的复杂意图。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.

papers.title_en: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
papers.authors: Hongru Cai, Ran Wei, Wenjie Wang, Chengfa Wu, Ning Song, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li
papers.evidence: 面向大模型的知识更新方法
papers.tldr: 条件记忆架构（如 DeepSeek Engram）用输入 n-gram 查表扩展 LLM 容量，有望把事实知识存储与通用计算解耦。但同一事实的不同表达会激活不同 n-gram 嵌入，直接更新共享嵌入易误伤其它事实。EngramEdit 先为多种表达求出目标记忆表示，再联合更新共享 n-gram 嵌入并加重惩罚高频复用嵌入，从而在固定 Transformer 主干下完成解耦知识更新，编辑成功率接近完美，改写知识可跨未见表达与多跳推理使用，CoT 提示下准确率约为最强基线的三倍，无关知识与通用能力基本保持。
papers.abstract_en: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.
